plan.baseline_parity_required: Both seed-196 baseline outputs in completed preliminary six-case diagnostic matched original production SDK token/PCM; both candidate repetitions and real ASR content passed
plan.outputs: Full per-case token and PCM hashes, EOS, duration, wall time; original PCM remains private
plan.pairing: Reuse each existing baseline for the same text/voice/seed; generate each independent subtalker-0.9 candidate once
plan.promotion_requirements: No candidate is promoted from this diagnostic alone. Any production change must retain interface/cancellation/update checks, pass the original strict two-hour target gate and fixed corpus regression, and obtain human listening evidence
plan.purpose: Predeclared independent subtalker-temperature candidate; compare with all retained original main-0.7/subtalker-0.7 baseline outputs; no production promotion
plan.quality_followup: After termination transcribe all 144 candidate outputs with unchanged final-App ASR; compare each to the retained 144 baseline outputs and ASR results
plan.stop_rule: Complete all predeclared cases regardless of EOS outcome; stop only on parity failure, process error or resource/time bounds
